description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the AddImage operation
description_zh: 本文档介绍添加图片数据AddImage的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imgsearch add-image --db-name default --image-url https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/imgsearch/xxxx.png --extra-data '风景' --entity-id 001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddImage

parameters.description_en: The name of the database. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 2 to 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 数据库名称。支持小写字母、数字、下划线组合，长度2~64。
parameters.help_en: The name of the database. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称。支持小写字母、数字、下划线组合，长度2~64
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.description_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
parameters.description_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。
parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.description_en: The custom data. The value can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters, and must be 0 to 512 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 自定义数据。支持字母、数据、标点符号、汉字。长度0~512。

parameters.description_en: The entity ID, which can be used as a data group ID. The ID can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.
